title: Renegotiation of Rural Debts
subtitle: Rural producers affected by climate events receive incentive to renegotiate debts
excerpt: CMN expands renegotiation of rural debts linked to climate events, offering new relief for affected producers.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Rural producers affected by climate events or other exceptional conditions have gained another incentive to renegotiate their debts.

CMN Decision

In an extraordinary meeting, the National Monetary Council (CMN) approved a measure aimed at helping rural producers renegotiate their debts.

This decision is significant for producers impacted by climate events or other exceptional circumstances, as it can aid their financial recovery.

With information from Agência Brasil.
